sql_reading_A.note: هنا شرط HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL ينطبق على الـHR org units، وده أقرب قراءة للنص لأن those تأتي مباشرة بعد HR org units.
sql_reading_A.sql:
SELECT
    o.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    AVG(TO_NUMBER(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE)) AS AVG_HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    VARIANCE(TO_NUMBER(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE)) AS VAR_HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(*) AS HR_ORG_UNIT_COUNT
FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o
JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h
    ON h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = o.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID
WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 'Y'
  AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS'
  AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')
  AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

sql_reading_B.note: هنا those with a non-null HR department code تُفسَّر على أنها organizations، باستخدام الـHR department code الموجود على organization نفسه، ثم تُحسب الـaggregations على الـHR org units المرتبطة بها.
sql_reading_B.sql:
SELECT
    o.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    AVG(TO_NUMBER(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE)) AS AVG_HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    VARIANCE(TO_NUMBER(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE)) AS VAR_HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(*) AS HR_ORG_UNIT_COUNT
FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o
JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h
    ON h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = o.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID
WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 'Y'
  AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS'
  AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')
  AND o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME;
